title: The Great Mouse Detective
about: A mouse detective in 1897 London takes on Professor Ratigan to rescue a kidnapped toymaker.
cue: Serve the snacks when Mrs Judson brings in the cheese crumpets.
faces: Toasted crumpets under melted cheddar and English mustard.
Soft boiled eggs wrapped in pork sausage, crumbed and fried.
Lamb mince with carrots and peas under mash.
Mouse Queen: "Ah, I just adore Jubilees.".
Butter sponge layers with strawberry jam and whipped cream.
Earl Grey tea with honey and lemon juice, over ice.
When the bell rings: Serve the snacks when Mrs Judson brings in the cheese crumpets.
